task_execution.description: Run at all. Only demanded when approval_mode=always; never derived from tools, labels or risk.

workspace_write.description: Create or change files inside the bound workspace. Unlocks local.write on the desktop gateway and the rw mount in the cloud sandbox.

git_push.description: Push to a remote. Unlocks the github egress profile and a repo-scoped installation token with contents:write.

pull_request.description: Open, edit, merge or close pull requests. Unlocks the github egress profile and pull_requests:write.

production_deploy.description: Run something that changes a live system: deploy scripts, wrangler/kubectl/terraform apply, systemctl on services.

destructive_command.description: Anything that can delete or that the classifier cannot prove safe: rm -rf, git reset --hard, DROP TABLE, and every unrecognised shell command.
